item.title: Microsoft Israel chief leaves amid ethical controversy
item.description:
📝 Haimovich left his position after an investigation by Microsoft's global management into Microsoft Israel’s work with the Ministry of Defense, amid concern that the company's code of ethics had been violated. Several managers in Microsoft Israel’s governance department have also left their positions. Microsoft Israel has been left without a country general manager, and "Globes" has learned that the global management has decided that for the time being Microsoft Israel will be managed directly by Microsoft France.
🔗 Read more: https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-microsoft-israel-chief-leaves-amid-ethical-controversy-1001542602
